recruitment_summary: Highly specialized recruitment for over 2,000+ vacancies across 300+ post categories. Candidates can apply for multiple posts but must pay separate fees for each.

overview.Selection_Process: CBT (Objective) + Skill Test (where applicable) + Scrutiny + DV

post_level_details.Syllabus_Focus: Basic Numerical Aptitude, General Intelligence (Non-Verbal), Elementary English
post_level_details.Typical_Posts: Staff Car Driver, Laboratory Attendant, Field Attendant, MTS

post_level_details.Syllabus_Focus: Arithmetic Operations, English (Grammar/Vocab), General Awareness (Scientific Observation)
post_level_details.Typical_Posts: Data Entry Operator, Lower Division Clerk (LDC), Stockman
Junior Engineer, Scientific Assistant, Senior Technical Assistant, Girls Cadet Instructor

application_fee.Note: If a candidate applies for 3 posts, they must pay ₹300 (if not exempted).

selection_process_milestones: 1. Computer Based Examination (CBT): Objective Multiple Choice.
3. Scrutiny: Submission of hard copies of documents to Regional Offices for shortlisted candidates.
4. Document Verification (DV): Final check by User Department/Ministry.

exam_pattern.Subject_Weights: 25 Qns / 50 Marks per subject (Reasoning, GA, Maths, English)
